tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG remains about 138bp (Aug 5 estimate). Reuters/Kpler's latest reviewed count was nine Hormuz commodity-vessel transits on Sep 24 against an 18-vessel 10-day average; Gulf of Oman ship-to-ship capacity was reported full. Iran's Sep 27 temporary route and fee instructions do not establish reopening. Maintain protection at 60-70%; stress (45%): 150-180bp; tail (40%): 200-230bp if attacks resume at scale. Reduce only after confirmed reopening and sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)
